one: Trustworthy agent systems: build a prototype, then use evaluation to make it reliable.
pos: CS 329T is a project-based course on the theme 'prototypes are easy, reliability is hard'. It covers foundation models, prompting, RAG, and agentic architectures, with an evaluation method for each; students finish with an evaluation-driven trustworthy agent application.
topics: **FMs and prompting**: capability boundaries, prompt patterns
**Evaluation**: offline metrics, LLM-as-judge, human evaluation, red teaming
**Team project**: build and evaluate an agent application
prereq: CS 229 or an equivalent Python ML course; deep learning (CS 230/CS 231N); familiarity with scikit-learn/Keras.
assess: Intro assignments (RAG/agent) plus a team project and an evaluation report. Check the current syllabus for details.
who: People who want to build agent products, AI evaluation, or trustworthy AI; anyone who can build a demo and wants evaluation methodology.
tips: Pair with CS 329Z: 329Z is more full-stack engineering, 329T is more trust + evaluation. Define metrics before writing code.
note: Not offered in the 2026–27 ExploreCourses listing.
